title: The adic completion of a flat module over a Noetherian ring is flat over the completed ring
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/I^n$ the $I$-adic completion of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $M$ a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $M^\wedge=\varprojlim_nM/I^nM$, an $R^\wedge$-module by $(r_n\bmod I^n)_n\cdot(x_n\bmod I^nM)_n=(r_nx_n\bmod I^nM)_n$. Then $M^\wedge$ is a flat $R^\wedge$-module.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0AGW (lemma-flat-after-completion, line 6527), in the case of a flat M over a Noetherian R: hypotheses (1), (2) hold as R is Noetherian, (3) M/IM = M (x)_R R/I is flat over R/I by Algebra Lemma 00HI (lemma-flat-base-change), (4) Tor_1^R(M, R/I) = 0 by Algebra Lemma 00M5 (lemma-characterize-flat); this is the use made of it in the proof of Lemma 0AGX

proof.text: For every $n\ge1$, $M/I^nM$ is a flat $R/I^n$-module. Indeed $M$ is flat over $R$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-base-change] applied to the quotient map $R\to R/I^n$ the $R/I^n$-module $R/I^n\otimes_RM$ is flat; and $R/I^n\otimes_RM\to M/I^nM$, $\bar r\otimes x\mapsto rx\bmod I^nM$, is an isomorphism of $R/I^n$-modules (right exactness of $-\otimes_RM$ applied to $I^n\to R\to R/I^n\to0$; the image of $I^n\otimes_RM\to M$ is $I^nM$). (In the source this is the first sentence of the proof of 0AGW, obtained there from hypotheses (3), (4) by Algebra Lemma 051C; for $M$ flat over $R$ it follows directly from Algebra Lemma 00HI, so no Tor is needed.)

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00HI (lemma-flat-base-change, line 8889), replacing in the proof of More on Algebra 0AGW the appeal to Algebra Lemma 051C (lemma-what-does-it-mean)

proof.text: Since $R$ is Noetherian, $I$ is finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $R^\wedge$ is a Noetherian ring by [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian]. Let $\iota:R\to R^\wedge$ be the canonical map and $J=IR^\wedge$. For each $n\ge1$ the projection $\pi_n:R^\wedge\to R/I^n$, $(r_k\bmod I^k)_k\mapsto r_n\bmod I^n$, is a surjective ring map with $\pi_n\circ\iota$ the quotient map and kernel $I^nR^\wedge$ [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-power]; and $J^n=I^nR^\wedge$ (both are generated by the products $\iota(a_1)\cdots\iota(a_n)$, $a_i\in I$). Hence $\pi_n$ induces a ring isomorphism $R^\wedge/J^n\cong R/I^n$.

source.place: proof of 0AGW, via Algebra Lemma Tag 05GG (lemma-hathat-finitely-generated) for R/I^n = R^/I^nR^ and Algebra Lemma Tag 05GH (lemma-completion-Noetherian), here its Noetherian-R case Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian)

proof.text: Set $M_n=M/I^nM$, an $R^\wedge$-module through $\pi_n$: $r\cdot\bar x=\pi_n(r)\bar x$. Then $J^nM_n=0$ since $J^n=\ker\pi_n$ (Step 2), and the $R^\wedge/J^n$-module $M_n$ is the $R/I^n$-module $M/I^nM$ transported along the isomorphism $R^\wedge/J^n\cong R/I^n$ of Step 2; flatness is preserved by transport of structure along a ring isomorphism, so by Step 1 $M_n$ is a flat $R^\wedge/J^n$-module. The transition maps $M_{n+1}=M/I^{n+1}M\to M/I^nM=M_n$, $x\bmod I^{n+1}M\mapsto x\bmod I^nM$, are surjective and $R^\wedge$-linear (as $\pi_n$ is $\pi_{n+1}$ followed by $R/I^{n+1}\to R/I^n$). Finally $\varprojlim_nM_n$ with its componentwise $R^\wedge$-module structure is $M^\wedge$ with the module structure of the statement: for $r=(r_k\bmod I^k)_k$, $r\cdot(x_n\bmod I^nM)_n=(\pi_n(r)x_n)_n=(r_nx_n\bmod I^nM)_n$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-limit-flat-modules] to the Noetherian ring $A=R^\wedge$ (Step 2), the ideal $J=IR^\wedge$ and the inverse system $(M_n)_n$ of Step 3, which satisfies its hypotheses (1) and (2). Hence $\varprojlim_nM_n=M^\wedge$ is a flat $R^\wedge$-module.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 0AGW (more-algebra.tex 6527) and 0912 (6475). Rather than stating the general 0AGW (which needs Tor_1 vanishing and the local flatness criterion 051C, neither available as nodes), the proof follows the proof of 0AGW specialized to a flat M over a Noetherian R: its only use of hypotheses (3), (4) is to get M/I^nM flat over R/I^n, which for flat M is Algebra 00HI directly. Steps: (1) M/I^nM flat over R/I^n by 00HI (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-base-change, Module.Flat.baseChange) and the elementary identification R/I^n (x) M = M/I^nM; (2) R^ Noetherian (lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian), R^/I^nR^ = R/I^n (lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-power, 05GG); (3) elementary transport: M/I^nM is a flat R^/(IR^)^n-module, surjective transitions, lim = M^ with the stated R^-structure; (4) new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-limit-flat-modules (More on Algebra 0912). stmt_deps unchanged. The tags in the brief were checked against tags/tags: 0AGW, 00HI, 00M5 correct; 0912 = lemma-limit-flat, 051C = lemma-what-does-it-mean, 05GG = lemma-hathat-finitely-generated, 05GH = lemma-completion-Noetherian. lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete (completeness of M^) is not needed by this route.
